/scripts.value:
on UpdateChat 
	lock screen
	local tStack
	local tGroupName
	local tChatArchive
	local tConvoName = "Quizli Quiz Create"
	local tMessageTotal
	local tTop,tLeft,tRight
	local tLinesWithQuestions
	local tMessageWithoutQuestions
	local tViewQuestionsPositionMarked
	local tNumberOfImages 
	local tMessageText
	local tTemp,tQuestions
	local tScrollerPlaceholder
	 
	put chatGroupElementID into tGroupName
	put "appligroup cs control " before tGroupName
	
	put chatScrollerPlaceholder into tScrollerPlaceholder
	put "rectangle cs control " before tScrollerPlaceholder
	
	put gPTConversations into tChatArchive
	put tChatArchive[tConvoName]["Message History"] into tChatArchive 
	put item 2 of the extents of tChatArchive into tMessageTotal
	
	 // SET STACK
	if exists(stack "Appli_Player") = true then 
		 put "Appli_Player" into tStack
	 else
		 put "Appli" into tStack
	 end if
	
	// DELETE OLD MESSGES WHEN IN DEVELOPMENT ENVIRONMENT
	if the environment = "development" then
		if exists(group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack) = true then
			delete group "Template" of group tGroupName of stack tStack 
			repeat with xGroup = the number of groups of group tGroupName of stack tStack down to 1
				if the short name of group xGroup of group tGroupName of stack tStack begins with "rectangle cs" then 
					next repeat
				end if
				delete group xGroup of group tGroupName of stack tStack 
			end repeat
		end if
	end if
	
	 // CHECK IF TEMPLATE EXISTS, IF IT EXISTS, THE CHAT WAS ALREADY VISITED
	// IF NOT, INITIALIZE EVERYTHING
	if exists(group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack) = false then 
		CreateTemplate
		if exists(group "Chat Scroller" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack) = false then
			create group "Chat Scroller" in group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
		end if
		set the lockloc of group "Chat Scroller" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true
		set the layermode of group "Chat Scroller" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "scrolling"
		set the rect of group "Chat Scroller" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the rect of group tScrollerPlaceholder of card "Playground" of stack tStack
	 end if
	
	// tTOP is the very top of the group, including the vscroll 
	set the vscroll of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 0 
	set the vscroll of group "Chat Scroller" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 0 
	put the top of rectangle "TL" of screen "Quizli AI V2" of card "Playground" of stack tStack into tTop
	//subtract the vscroll of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack from tTop 
	put the left of rectangle "TL" of screen "Quizli AI V2" of card "Playground" of stack tStack into tLeft 
	put the right of rectangle "TR" of screen "Quizli AI V2" of card "Playground" of stack tStack into tRight
	add 100 to tTop
	
	 //DO WE HAVE ENOUGH TEMPLATES TO COVER?
	repeat with xMessage = 2 to tMessageTotal
		put empty into tViewQuestionsPositionMarked
		// DOES A GROUP EXIST TO DISPLAY THIS MESSAGE?
		if exists(group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack) = false then
			CreateMessageGroup xMessage
		 end if
		
		set the visible of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true
		
		// UPDATE THE MESSAGE BUBBLE
		put tChatArchive[xMessage]["content"] into tMessageWithoutQuestions
		
		set the lockloc of field "text" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true
		set the width of field "text" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to round(the width of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack / 3) 
		set the dontwrap of field "text" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false
		 put 0 into tNumberOfImages
		
		if tChatArchive[xMessage]["content"][1]["text"] is not empty then
			put tChatArchive[xMessage]["content"][1]["text"] into tMessageText
		else if tChatArchive[xMessage]["content"] is not empty then
			put tChatArchive[xMessage]["content"] into tMessageText
		end if
		
		if tChatArchive[xMessage]["role"] = "assistant" then
			try
				put jsonImport(CleanJSONString(tMessageText)) into tMessageText
				// MUST FIX ARRAY FIRST
				if the keys of tMessageText contains "questions" then
					put tMessageText["questions"] into tQuestions
					put tMessageText["message"] into tMessageText
				else if the keys of tMessageText contains "properties" then
					//answer "the array bug happened. GPT returned incorrect array nested in a 'properties' key: This is here just to see how often it happens"
					put tMessageText["properties"] into tMessageText
					put tMessageText["questions"] into tQuestions
					put tMessageText["message"] into tMessageText
				else
					answer "an unknown error happened, the response is not correct."
				end if
				
				
				catch tError
				if the environment = "development" then
					answer tError
				end if
			end try 
		end if
		
		set the text of field "text" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to tMessageText
		
		if tChatArchive[xMessage]["content"] is an array then
			// COULD INCLUDE IMAGES
			// PROCESS IMAGES
			local tTheImage
			
			repeat with xContentIndex = 2 to item 2 of the extents of tChatArchive[xMessage]["content"]
				add 1 to tNumberOfImages
				if exists(Image ("Image " & tNumberOfImages) of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack) = true then
				else
					copy image "Image 1" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
					set the name of it to ("Image " & tNumberOfImages)
					set the text of it to empty
				end if
				
				put tChatArchive[xMessage]["content"][xContentIndex]["image_url"]["url"] into tTheImage
				replace "data:image/jpeg;base64," with empty in tTheImage
				replace "data:image/png;base64," with empty in tTheImage
				set the text of image ("Image " & tNumberOfImages) of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to base64decode(tTheImage)
				setHeightProportional the long id of image ("Image " & tNumberOfImages) of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack, 50
			end repeat
			else	
		end if
		
		set the height of field "text" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to (the formattedheight of field "text" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack)
		
		// DO WE NEED A VIEW QUESTIONS BUTTON?
		// HEIGHT OF FIELD TEXT IS NOW THE RELATIVE CONTROL FOR SETTING THE SIZE OF OTHER MESSAGE BUBBLE ELEMENT
		//RESIZE
		
		if tNumberOfImages > 0 then
			set the height of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the formattedheight of field "text" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack + 130
		else
			set the height of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the formattedheight of field "text" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack + 30
		end if
		
		set the width of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to formattedwidth of field "text" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack + 30
		
		set the rect of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the rect of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
		set the rect of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the rect of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
		set the rect of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the rect of of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
		
		set the top of field "text" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the top of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack + 15
		set the left of field "text" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the left of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack + 10 - the margins of field "text" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
		
		local tNextLeft, tNextTop
		put the left of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack + 10 into tNextLeft
		put the bottom of field "text" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack + 5 into tNextTop
		
		repeat with xImage = 1 to tNumberOfImages
			// ALIGN THE IMAGES IN THIS MESSAGE TO THE BOTTOM OF THE BUBBLE
			set the left of image ("Image " & xImage) of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to tNextLeft
			set the top of image ("Image " & xImage) of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to tNextTop
			
			if the right of image ("Image " & xImage) of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack > the right of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack then
				put the left of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack + 10 into tNextLeft
				add 60 to tNextTop
				set the left of image ("Image " & xImage) of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to tNextLeft
				set the top of image ("Image " & xImage) of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to tNextTop
				
			else
			end if
			
			add the width of image ("Image " & xImage) of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack + 5 to tNextLeft
			set the visible of image ("Image " & xImage) of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true
			
		end repeat
		
		// FIX HEIGHT OF BACKGROUND IF IMAGES WERE ADDED
		if tNumberOfImages > 0 then
			set the height of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to (the bottom of image ("Image " & tNumberOfImages) of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack - the top of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack) + 5
		end if
		
		
		set the rect of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the rect of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
		set the rect of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the rect of of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
		
		
		set the style of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "roundrect"
		set the roundRadius of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 25
		
		set the top of graphic "bubble" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the bottom of graphic "bg" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack + 10
		set the showborder of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false
		
		if tChatArchive[xMessage]["role"] = "assistant" then
			set the left of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to tLeft + 10
		else if tChatArchive[xMessage]["role"] = "user" then
			set the right of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to tRight - 50
		end if
		
		// ALIGN THE BUTTON
		
		set the width of graphic "Button" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 150
		set the height of graphic "Button" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 30
		
		set the top of graphic "Button" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the formattedtop of line tViewQuestionsPositionMarked of field "text" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack - (the textsize of field "text" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack )
		set the left of graphic "Button" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the formattedleft of line tViewQuestionsPositionMarked of field "text" of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
		
		set the top of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to tTop
		add the height of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to tTop
		add 32 to tTop
		set the visible of group ("message " & xMessage) of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true
	end repeat
	
	// PREPARE THE QUESTIONS LIST
	local tScroll
	
	unlock screen
	
	if the formattedheight of group "Chat Scroller" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack > the height of group "Chat Scroller" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack then
		set the vscrollbar of group "Chat Scroller" of group tGroupName of stack tStack to true
		set the vscroll of group "Chat Scroller" of group tGroupName of stack tStack to (the formattedheight of group "Chat Scroller" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack - the height of group "Chat Scroller" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack)
	else
		set the vscrollbar of group "Chat Scroller" of group tGroupName of stack tStack to false
	end if
end UpdateChat 


on CreateTemplate
	 // HERE WE CREATE THE TEMPLATE FOR A CHAT BUBBLE
	 // A CHAT BUBBLE NEEDS A BACKGROUND, TEXT, IMAGE, BUTTON, SECONDARY BUBBLE
	 local tStack,tScript
	 local tGroupName 
	 local tChatArchive
	 put ChatGroupElementID into tGroupName
	put "appligroup cs control " before tGroupName
	 // SET STACK
	if exists(stack "Appli_Player") = true then
		 put "Appli_Player" into tStack
	 else
		 put "Appli" into tStack
	 end if
	
	 // GROUP 
	 create group "Template" in group tGroupName of group "center" of card "Playground" of stack tStack
	 set the opaque of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false
	 set the visible of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false
	 set the threed of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false
	 set the margins of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 0
	 set the lockloc of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true
	 set the showborder of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false
	
	 
	 // BACKDROP 
	 create graphic "bg" in group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
	 set the opaque of graphic "bg" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true
	 set the style of graphic "bg" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "roundrect"
	 set the roundradius of graphic "bg" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 33
	 set the blendlevel of graphic "bg" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 0
	 set the height of graphic "bg" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 400
	 set the width of graphic "bg" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 300
	 set the linesize of graphic "bg" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 2 
	set the foregroundcolor of graphic "bg" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "#75BC6F"
	set the backgroundcolor of graphic "bg" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "#FFFFFF"
	
	 // MESSAGE TEXT
	 create field "Text" in group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
	 set the opaque of field "Text" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false
	 set the threed of field "Text" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false
	 set the showborder of field "Text" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false
	 set the locktext of field "Text" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true
	 set the showfocusborder of field "Text" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false
	 set the traversalon of field "Text" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false
	set the textColor of field "Text" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "#75BC6F"
	set the textSize of field "Text" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 20
	
	 // IMAGE -- FOR WHEN USER IS SENDING IMAGES
	 create image "Image 1" in group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
	 set the visible of image "Image 1" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false
	set the showborder of image "Image 1" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true
	set the borderwidth of image "Image 1" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 1
	set the bordercolor of image "Image 1" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "#EEEEEE"
	set the height of image "Image 1" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 100
	 set the width of image "Image 1" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 100
	 set the lockloc of image "Image 1" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true
	 set the threed of image "Image 1" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false
	
	 // BUTTON TO PERFORM AN ACTION 
	 create graphic "button" in group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
	 set the opaque of graphic "button" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true
	 set the style of graphic "button" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "roundrect"
	 set the roundradius of graphic "button" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 10
	 set the blendlevel of graphic "button" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 10
	 set the label of graphic "button" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "VIEW QUESTIONS"
	 set the visible of graphic "button" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false
	 set the showname of graphic "button" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true
	 set the backgroundcolor of graphic "button" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "#75BC6F"
	 set the foregroundcolor of graphic "button" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "#FFFFFF"
	 set the textStyle of graphic "button" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "bold"
	
	
	// SET SCRIPT TO TRIGGER CUSTOM EVENT
	put "on mouseUp" into tScript
	put lf & "dispatch " & quote & "ViewQuestions" & quote after tScript
	put " to " after tScript
	put "group " & quote & tGroupName & quote after tScript
	put " of card " & quote & "Playground" & quote after tScript 
	put " of stack " & quote & tStack & quote after tScript
	put lf & "end mouseUp" after tScript
	set the script of 	graphic "button" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to tScript
	
	 // BUBBLE BELOW EACH MESSAGE
	 create graphic "bubble" in group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack 
	 set the opaque of graphic "bubble" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to true
	 set the showborder of graphic "bubble" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false
	 set the style of graphic "bubble" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to "oval"
	 set the blendlevel of graphic "bubble" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 10
	 set the height of graphic "bubble" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 30
	 set the width of graphic "bubble" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to 30 
	 set the visible of graphic "bubble" of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to false
	set the loc of group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to the loc of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
end CreateTemplate 
 
on CreateMessageGroup pMessageNumber
	local tGroupName,tStack 
	put ChatGroupElementID into tGroupName 
	put "appligroup cs control " before tGroupName
	 // SET STACK
	if exists(stack "Appli_Player") = true then
		 put "Appli_Player" into tStack
	 else
		 put "Appli" into tStack 
	 end if
	copy group "Template" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to group "Chat Scroller" of group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack
	set the name of it to "message " & pMessageNumber
end CreateMessageGroup


command setAreaProportional pImageID, pWidth, pHeight
	
	 local tProportionalWidth, tProportionalHeight, tRatio
	 put ((the formattedWidth of pImageID) / pWidth) into tRatio
	 put round((the formattedHeight of pImageID) / tRatio) into tProportionalHeight
	 put ((the formattedHeight of pImageID) / pHeight) into tRatio
	 put round((the formattedWidth of pImageID) / tRatio) into tProportionalWidth
	 if tProportionalHeight > pHeight then
		 lock screen 
		 set the width of pImageID to tProportionalWidth
		 set the height of pImageID to pHeight
		 unlock screen
	 else
		 lock screen
		 set the width of pImageID to pWidth
		 set the height of pImageID to tProportionalHeight
		 unlock screen
	 end if
end setAreaProportional

command scaleImage pImageID, pScale
	 local tWidth, tHeight
	 put the formattedWidth of pImageID into tWidth
	 put the formattedHeight of pImageID into tHeight
	 
	 put tWidth * pScale into tWidth
	 put tHeight * pScale into tHeight
	 
	 lock screen
	 set the width of pImageID to tWidth
	 set the height of pImageID to tHeight
	 unlock screen
end scaleImage

command setWidthProportional pImageID, pWidth
	 local tRatio, tHeight
	 put ((the formattedWidth of pImageID) / pWidth) into tRatio
	 put round((the formattedHeight of pImageID) / tRatio) into tHeight
	 
	 lock screen
	 set the width of pImageID to pWidth
	 set the height of pImageID to tHeight
	 unlock screen
end setWidthProportional
 
command setHeightProportional ThisImage, pHeight
	 local tRatio, tWidth
	 put ((the formattedHeight of ThisImage) / pHeight) into tRatio
	 put round((the formattedWidth of ThisImage) / tRatio) into tWidth
	 lock screen
	 set the width of ThisImage to tWidth
	 set the height of ThisImage to pHeight
	 unlock screen
end setHeightProportional

function cleanJSONString pJSONString
	return pJSONString
end cleanJSONString
